functions.name: Ene
functions.role: Strips matching complete outer reminder wrapper when called; not a global serialization pass.

functions.name: uZe
functions.role: Calls Ene for strings and every text block, returns null for non-text blocks, joins texts.

functions.name: hT
functions.role: w=S7(model); H=w&&fvr(model). Promotable attachments under w use uZe(pi); H rewraps result with Yl, otherwise bare text can aggregate into api_system. Fallback user/tool-result branches can preserve wrappers.

functions.name: lLn
functions.role: Can fold reminder text into tool_result.content under branch conditions.

functions.name: Xyr
functions.role: Serializes user through eyr, api_system to role:system. No unconditional removal of system-reminder tags.

functions.name: eyr
functions.role: Preserves user message text while applying content/caching normalization.

functions.name: S7
functions.role: Uses model capability midConversationSystem with zF fallback.

functions.name: fvr
functions.role: Returns We(model)==="claude-sonnet-5"; hT rewrap condition H depends on this and w.
